findings.location: Abraham said to Sarah, Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee –Genesis 12:13.
findings.source_quote: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee –Genesis 12:13.
findings.suggested_fix:
将引文按原文含义忠实翻译为中文，保持经文所载的句子与章节标引。建议译文例如：
“你要对他们说：‘我恳求你，你是我的妹妹’，好叫我因你得平安；我的性命因你得保全。──创世记 12:13。”
（保留原文中引号或斜体标示经文的样式）
findings.translation_quote: 你既为我有益，我必因此得存性命──创世记 12:13。

findings.location: Opening quoted Scripture paragraph (2 Timothy 1:4-7) — names of Lois and Eunice
findings.source_quote: ...the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also. ... –2 Timothy 1:4-7.
findings.suggested_fix: 确认人名的常用中文音译与文章其余处保持一致。原文人名 Lois 与 Eunice 在译文中分别为“Lois / Eunice”。建议使用常见教会译名“罗伊斯（或洛伊）”和“以尼基”，并在文中前后一致。示例：将“罗伊”改为“罗伊斯”或“洛伊（Lois）”，并统一全文出现处。
findings.translation_quote: ……先在你外祖母罗伊、你母亲以尼基心里的信…… –提摩太后书 1:4-7。
